Summary: KRYL-1395 (Tooling): guest-journey harness, undeclared-identifier check, error boundary and dev health check (close failure classes, not instances)
Description: 1) Original intent (Founder and team, 2026-10-10): stop finding failure classes one pasted example at a time; verify the whole guest path before a result reaches the Founder. 2) Acceptance criteria: qa_journeys.mjs drives the real app headlessly through a fixed set of queries (registry company, public non-registry company, second non-registry company, private company, markdown prompt, themed question) and asserts no blank screen, no page errors, the right resolution state, temporal comparison reaching the brief or a stated limitation, no domain-word participants, no 'Failed to fetch' in guest text; scripts/check-undef.mjs flags any new identifier used but declared nowhere in a file (baseline of existing findings); an error boundary shows a named panel instead of a blank page for a render error; scripts/dev-health.mjs reports suspended or duplicate Vite servers, the served build, the engine and memory pressure. 3) Current implementation state: built on Dev, commit 36a377f: qa_journeys.mjs (6 journeys, all passing), scripts/check-undef.mjs (550 files scanned, 1 baseline finding, reproduces the BRT bug when reintroduced), src/components/errorboundary.jsx (app root and the structural brief; unit-tested, not live-forced), scripts/dev-health.mjs, npm scripts check:undef, dev:check, qa:journeys, predev runs the check in warning mode. 4) Dependencies: dev server and engine for the journeys; the entity admission path (KRYL-1380) for the two public-company journeys. 5) Superseded by a newer ticket: none. 6) Maps to current product model: yes (supports sections 10, 22 and 23 verification). Not yet covered: the planned ~50 journeys (6 exist), automatic run before hand-off, gap telemetry.
